technical.summary: Strong bullish confluence with three white soldiers, rising RSI, and price above all major MAs, but overbought conditions on short-term RSI and lack of triggered strategies suggest caution on entry timing.

fundamental.summary: No detectable insider or institutional signals with 89 days to earnings creates neutral positioning with insufficient conviction data.

sentiment.summary: Fear sentiment (VIX proxy at 30) presents contrarian buying opportunity, though neutral AAII positioning and commercial hedging suggest mixed conviction; congressional data absent.

risk.summary: FOMC event occurred 1 day ago with elevated VIX at 30.5 in normal yield curve; elevated volatility and recent major event create unfavourable conditions for swing trade entry.

debate.key_bull_argument: Three white soldiers pattern with price above all major moving averages and rising RSI-9 creates strong technical confluence at a contrarian buying opportunity in fear-driven market conditions.
debate.key_bear_argument: Trade is explicitly blocked by elevated VIX (30.5) within 1 day of FOMC event, dual RSI overbought readings (76.4/72.92) signal exhaustion, and absence of triggered strategies with zero fundamental/insider conviction undermine entry quality.

decision.entry_rationale: Technical bullish signals (three white soldiers, RSI-9 rising, price above MAs) are contradicted by explicit trade block due to elevated VIX (30.5) within 1 day of FOMC, dual RSI overbought exhaustion, and zero fundamental/insider conviction.
decision.primary_risk: Elevated macro volatility post-FOMC combined with short-term RSI overbought conditions (76.4/72.92) creates high probability of mean reversion pullback before any upside continuation.
